Every aiui command and option. aiui --help prints the same information from the installed version. The wheel also installs the command as praisonaiui. For a short tour of the commands you will use most, see CLI Usage.

Run the server for a Python app (app.py) or a YAML chat agent (chat.yaml). Option Default Description APP_FILE required A Python file that registers callbacks, or a .yaml/.yml chat config --port, -p 8000 Port. If it is taken, the next free port (up to 10 further) is used. The port is bound before the URL is printed and the server serves that socket, so two apps started together never get the same port --host 127.0.0.1 Address to bind to --reload, -r off Restart when files change --style, -s detected app (the React app shell, default), chat (the classic chat), docs, agents, playground, dashboard (legacy) or custom --preset minimal for app.py Page preset: minimal (Chat + your pages), agent (Chat, Sessions, Approvals, Usage, Memory), or ops (all built-in ops pages) --pages none Explicit comma-separated page IDs (e.g. chat,sessions), all, or a preset name (minimal, agent, ops) --backend, -b standalone standalone, or praisonai to use the PraisonAI WebSocket gateway --datastore, -d sdk Session storage: sdk (shared with PraisonAI Agents), sdk:/path, json, json:/path or memory. Without the flag, a chat YAML's datastore: key is used --config, -c none A docs-site YAML to build before serving (optional) --output, -o aiui Folder the UI files are written to; by default next to APP_FILE Style: for a Python app --style wins, then aiui.set_style(); for a YAML app its style: key wins over --style. Without any of them aiui run detects one: @aiui.profiles plus registered agents gives agents, and anything else (including @aiui.reply and @aiui.page) opens app (the React app shell). For Python app.py files that do not call aiui.set_pages(), aiui run defaults to the minimal preset (Chat + your own pages) unless --preset, --pages, or AIUI_PAGES is set. In app, aiui run opens the chat layout (the chat without a canvas) unless AIUI_LAYOUT, aiui.set_layout() or YAML layout: picks another. See UI Styles, Layouts, and Build a focused app. A chat YAML's top-level keys: name, instructions, model, welcome, goodbye, starters, profiles, tools, features, datastore, style, theme, branding, dashboard, pages, layout and extensions. layout: takes a layout id (layout: command) or the same block as aiui.yaml (default, available, user_choice, primary, options); extensions: takes enabled: / disabled: lists, as in aiui.yaml. Any other key prints a warning naming it, since it would otherwise be ignored without a word. aiui run loads ~/.praisonai/.env and then ./.env before starting, without overriding variables that are already set.

Scaffold a starter Python Agent UI (app.py) or a Docs UI config (aiui.yaml) in the current folder. Refuses to overwrite existing files unless --force is given. Option Default Description --template, -t minimal App templates (writes app.py): agent, openai, anthropic, langgraph, crewai, pydantic-ai, praisonai, dashboard. Docs templates (writes aiui.yaml): minimal, docs, marketing --force, -f off Overwrite existing files --frontend off Also scaffold a Vite + React + shadcn frontend project For docs templates, the file's first line (# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://ui.praison.ai/aiui.schema.json) gives autocomplete and hover docs in editors (Editor setup). Create the folder it points to (for the docs template, ./docs with at least one .md file) before aiui build.

Check a docs-site configuration and its pages. Option Default Description --config, -c aiui.yaml Configuration file (lookup) --strict off Unknown keys, broken links, nav entries without a page and content issues (7xxx) become errors (exit 1) --format text json prints {valid, errors, warnings}, each with code, file, line, message, suggestion Each finding prints as [category] code file:line: message with a fix hint under it: Code Finding 1003 unknown key (ignored); in a $ref file the file is named 1004 key accepted but has no effect; unknown component tag in a page 2101 a nav entry names no docs page 2102 a navigation tab, menu item, anchor or dropdown with no pages, groups or href 5001, 51xx, 5201 theme, layout and search settings that are ignored 6001, 6002 broken link or missing image (aiui docs check-links); OpenAPI spec problems 7000 page front matter is not valid YAML (the page loses its title) 7001 front matter key has the wrong type (keys) 7002 image without alt text (`, with noalt;alt="" marks a decorative image) 7003 two files publish the same page URL (intro.md and 01-intro.md) 7004 two sidebar entries in one folder have the same title 7005 heading skips a level (## then ####) 7006 page has nothing beyond its headings 7007 {{name}} with no value under variables: (variables) 7008 snippet not found, outside the project folder, or including itself (fails aiui build) 7009 icon (front matter, navigation, a component's icon="…") that is not a lucide name, an emoji or an image URL, with the nearest name 7010 a redirect loops, or ends at a docs path with no page (redirects) 7011 a page is published at a redirect's source, so the redirect never runs 7012 front matter openapi: / api: or a navigation METHOD /path entry that names no operation in the loaded specs (OpenAPI) 7013 front matter related names a page that does not exist (related pages) 7014 a site.customCss, site.customJs, site.theme.fonts or site.theme.codeLanguages file that is not in the project folder (fonts and custom files) 7015 site.theme.code names a theme that is not bundled (with the nearest name), or a site.theme.codeLanguages file is not a TextMate grammar (code blocks) 7016 a ::: module block names no module or member, or has an unknown option (fails aiui build; Python API reference) 7017 content.docs.auth is set, and only aiui serve / aiui dev enforce it (aiui build); front matter public / groups without content.docs.auth, or a group no reader is in (docs sign-in) 7018 two navigation.versions with the same name, more than one marked default: true, or a version that lists a page of another version's folder (versions) 7019 raw HTML a page shows differently than written: an that is not a YouTube, Vimeo or Loom video (shown as a link; the host is named), or , , , , , , (removed). Also an aiui build warning (raw HTML) 7020 two navigation.languages with the same code, more than one marked default: true, or a version folder inside a language folder (docs/fr/v1/; languages) 7021 site.components is not a .js / .mjs file in the project folder, or the build finds no component tag in it (your own components) 7022 a class on a component tag or raw HTML that docs pages drop (not a docs utility class; the nearest allowed one is suggested), or a style attribute (always removed). Also an aiui build warning (styling with classes) 7101 site.theme.accent under WCAG AA 3:1 contrast on the light or dark background, with a shade that passes 7102 logo, favicon or site.theme.background image that is not a file in the project folder (branding) Without --config, validate, build and serve read ./aiui.yaml. The old name aiui.template.yaml still works: when it is the only one there it is used, with a one-line hint on stderr to rename it, and the exit code is unchanged. When both files exist, aiui.yaml wins. An explicit --config always wins and prints no hint. See Config file name.

Print the JSON Schema of aiui.yaml, generated from the Config model of the installed version; --output, -o writes it to a file. The schema is also published at https://ui.praison.ai/aiui.schema.json; see Editor setup.

Build a static docs site from the configuration. Option Default Description --config, -c aiui.yaml Configuration file (lookup) --output, -o aiui Output folder --minify off Minify the JSON manifests --strict off Stop with exit code 1 on a broken link (without it, broken links are warnings) The output holds index.html, 404.html, the UI bundle (assets/, aiui-manifest.json), the manifests (ui-config.json, docs-nav.json, route-manifest.json), one HTML file and the Markdown source per page, robots.txt and .nojekyll. sitemap.xml, llms.txt and llms-full.txt are added when the site URL is known (seo.siteUrl, or a CNAME file next to the configuration or in docs/).

Find broken page links, #anchors, images, component hrefs and nav entries before you deploy. Prints file:line: target: reason (did you mean X?) and exits 1 when a link is broken. See Writing docs pages → Check links. Option Default Description --config, -c aiui.yaml Configuration file --external off Also request every http(s) URL (HEAD, then GET; 16 at a time) --timeout 10 Seconds to wait for each external URL --json off Print {"checked", "pages", "broken": [{file, line, target, reason, suggestion}]}

Build (unless --no-build) and serve a docs site. Option Default Description --config, -c aiui.yaml Configuration file (lookup) --output, -o aiui Folder to serve --port, -p 8000 Port (next free port if taken) --host 127.0.0.1 Address to bind to --no-build off Serve the existing output without building --watch, -w off Rebuild when a file in the configuration's folder changes (reload the page yourself; aiui dev reloads it for you) --cors-origins empty Comma-separated allowed origins; empty means same-origin only --ssl-certfile none Certificate file for HTTPS --ssl-keyfile none Private key file for HTTPS --open / --no-open auto Open the site in a browser. Auto opens it only when run from a terminal; never in CI, under a test runner or from a script (when a browser opens) Paths without a file extension fall back to the single-page app. Paths that try to leave the output folder are refused. Every response carries the /* headers of the build's _headers file, which holds the site's Content Security Policy. #### When a browser opens aiui serve, aiui dev and aiui dev --examples open a browser tab only for a person at a terminal. With neither flag, the tab opens when standard output is a terminal and no CI or test runner is detected (CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITLAB_CI, BUILDKITE, PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST). --open forces it, --no-open skips it, and AIUI_NO_BROWSER=1 turns it off everywhere, for scripts and coding agents that start these servers.

Preview the docs site while you write it: build, serve, and reload the open browser tab on every save. A failed build is shown in the terminal and over the page while the last good build stays up. Run it in the folder that holds aiui.yaml, or in a folder with only a docs/ folder. See Hot Reload. Option Default Description --config, -c aiui.yaml Configuration file (lookup) --port, -p 8000 Port (next free port if taken) --host 127.0.0.1 Address to bind to --open / --no-open auto Open the preview in a browser; auto as for aiui serve (when a browser opens) --base-path as aiui build URL path to preview the site under --examples, -e none Run the examples dashboard for this folder instead (default port 9000) aiui dev --examples examples is the older dashboard that lists the example projects in a folder and switches between them. In a folder with no configuration and no docs/ but an examples/ folder, plain aiui dev still opens it.

Command Options Description aiui doctor --server, -s (default http://127.0.0.1:8000), --json Structured diagnostics against a running server. The first two checks need no server: aiui Version (the imported version against PyPI's latest) and aiui Install (the version and folder actually imported; warns when pip's metadata names another version, as a stale editable install does, and prints the reinstall command) aiui health-check --server, -s, --detailed, -d Server health; --detailed shows each feature aiui health same Alias of health-check aiui test --server, -s (default http://127.0.0.1:8082) Integration tests against a running server: chat, memory, sessions, endpoints, features, all. See API Testing

--config applies the extensions: policy from that YAML. doctor checks the entry point, the SDK version gate, static_dir and SRI hashes, and (unless --no-builtin) page ids that a built-in page shadows. A plugin's own commands run as aiui ... or aiui plugins ...; AIUI_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 turns that lookup off. See UI plugins.
These talk to a running server over HTTP. Every one takes --server, -s URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000).
Runtime configuration (stored in config.yaml under the data directory).
A2UI surfaces for the agent canvas; see A2UI Overview.
Manage in-app notifications (NotificationStoreProtocol, REST + SSE); see Notifications.
Inspect live HTTP latency, throughput, memory, and recorded metrics.
aiui auth create-secret prints a new session secret (offline; see Sessions); aiui auth create-key --name my-app creates an API key on the running server and prints it once.
Code Meaning 0 Success 1 Invalid configuration, failed request or other error 2 File or folder not found, or an unknown --style 3 Build failed 4 No free port near the requested one

Variable Effect AIUI_DATA_DIR Data directory (default ~/.praisonaiui): sessions, runtime config.yaml, plugin state AIUI_SHELL app turns the dashboard style into the React app shell; legacy turns app back into dashboard AIUI_LAYOUT Default app-shell layout id; see Layouts AIUI_TEMPLATES_DIR Serve or build with another frontend bundle folder AIUI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS Origins allowed for cross-site requests and WebSockets (comma-separated, or *) AIUI_ALLOWED_HOSTS Extra host names a loopback or private-address server answers AIUI_REQUIRE_TOKEN Require the URL token on every request AUTH_ENFORCE true gates every route and WebSocket behind auth AIUI_AUTH_SECRET Session signing secret (comma-separated to rotate: first signs, all verify); default a generated /auth_secret AIUI_SESSION_LIFETIME How long a sign-in lasts while unused (14d default, 12h, 3600); overrides YAML auth.sessionLifetime AIUI_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD 1 stops loading plugin CLI commands PRAISONAI_MODEL Default model for built-in agent features (default gpt-4o-mini) OPENAI_API_KEY Used by agent features and examples that call OpenAI The security variables are described in Deployment.
